"""Freeze all four V162 endpoints and six retained native comparators."""
import ast
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V162-flat-target-anchor-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);previous=Path(plan['previous'])
old=previous/'postprocess-v1/scripts';post=root/'postprocess-v1/scripts';post.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
for name in ['train_v43_quality_trial.py','report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet.py','profile_raw_kernel_inference.py',
    'report_checkpoint_pilot.py','train_directional_bank_trial.py']:shutil.copyfile(old/name,post/name)
shutil.copyfile(Path(plan['work'])/'scripts/review_flat_target_anchor_trial.py',post/'review_flat_target_anchor_trial.py')
for name in ['score','audit','render']:
    text=(old/f'{name}_harmonic_context_trial.py').read_text().replace('_harmonic_context_trial','_flat_target_anchor_trial')
    text=text.replace('V161','V162').replace('50764800','54451200').replace('paired1k','V162')
    if name=='render':
        needle='names = ["Noisy Malvar","V143 parent","Pair ctrl raw1k","Pair ctrl EMA1k","Harmonic raw1k","Harmonic EMA1k"]'
        assert needle in text
        text=text.replace(needle,'names = ["Noisy Malvar","V143 parent","Harm ctrl raw1k","Harm ctrl EMA1k","Flat anchor raw1k","Flat anchor EMA1k"]')
        text=text.replace('V156 detail/V157 coarse/V158 quiet/V159 compromise/V160 ordinary',
            'V156 detail/V157 coarse/V158 quiet/V159 compromise/V160 ordinary/V160 paired')
    ast.parse(text);(post/f'{name}_flat_target_anchor_trial.py').write_text(text)
retained=read(previous/'postprocess-plan-v1.json')['retained_native_collections']
assert len(retained)==5
v161plan=read(previous/'plan-v1.json')
retained=dict(retained);retained['V160 paired EMA']=v161plan['control_collections']['paired-control-EMA-step1000']
cases=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations'];assert len(retained)==6
for binding in retained.values():
    assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
    collection=read(binding['path'])
    assert [r['id'] for r in collection['observations']]==[c['id'] for c in cases]
    assert all(r['parent']==c['parent'] for r,c in zip(collection['observations'],cases,strict=True))
save(root/'native-retained-comparators-v1.json',{'collections':retained,'new_forwards':0,
    'scope':'Six fixed retained columns:V156 raw,V157 EMA,V158 EMA,V159 EMA,V160 ordinary EMA,V160 paired EMA. Current harmonic controls exactly reproduce V161 raw/EMA. Same822 input/parent bindings;no extra forwards for retained columns.'})
shared=repo/'.cache/quality-20261103'
metrics=[shared/'collaborative-detail-v1/transfer-v1.py',shared/'collaborative-detail-v1/audit-transfer-v1.py',
    shared/'V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py']
env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=':'.join(str(p) for p in [post,Path(plan['work'])/'scripts',Path(plan['work'])/'src']),
    OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1')
cmd='from pathlib import Path;from score_flat_target_anchor_trial import load_module;'+f'r=Path({str(shared)!r});'
cmd+='load_module(r/"collaborative-detail-v1/transfer-v1.py","errors");'
cmd+='load_module(r/"collaborative-detail-v1/audit-transfer-v1.py","independent_late_spectral_metrics");'
cmd+='load_module(r/"V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py","photos");'
cmd+='import review_flat_target_anchor_trial,audit_flat_target_anchor_trial,render_flat_target_anchor_trial;print("PASS actual primary/independent metrics,review and render imports")'
run=subprocess.run([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',cmd],cwd=repo,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
assert run.returncode==0,(run.stdout,run.stderr)
save(root/'postprocess-import-preflight-v1.json',{'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'returncode':run.returncode,
    'stdout':run.stdout,'stderr':run.stderr,'command':cmd,'metrics':[ref(p) for p in metrics],
    'retained_native_collections':retained,'sources':{str(p):ref(p)['sha256'] for p in post.glob('*.py')},
    'new_neural_forwards':0,'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
print(run.stdout.strip());print('Frozen9 postprocess sources/six retained columns;54451200 native RGB channels')
